QUOTE: "Only what the application starts. The library creates no threads." and "Every mutex field, lock call, and the `mbedtls_mutex_*` function pointers are inside `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`" / "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` or `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads, but it frames the mutex layer as compiled out and per-context locks, not as an abstraction the library supplies for threaded callers (pthread/alt mutex wrappers), so the second half of the contrast is not clearly stated.
